# Theme Radar

> Thematic equity research and the baskets that track it. Free and open. Market data to the 2026-11-03 close.

Research pieces are written as theses with named tickers, dated numbers and sources. Each idea is tracked as a basket from its start date.

## Research
- [Binance heist: what it means for our cyber basket](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/binance-heist-cyber-basket.md): 2026-11-04. Theme: Cybersecurity. PANW, SAIL, FROG, CRWD, DDOG, NET. The largest crypto theft on record ran through a poisoned package, a fake job offer, an over-privileged token and an internal AI tool. No change to the basket, but it points to identity and software supply chain. A fear-driven slowdown in AI agents helps the basket. A return-driven one is the real risk.
- [Cybersecurity hardware: Fortinet and F5](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/cyber-hardware-ftnt-ffiv.md): 2026-11-02. Theme: Cybersecurity. FTNT, FFIV. Both names fell about 20% on earnings in the same week. The moat is being physically in the data path inside the customer's building, which AI cannot vibe-code. Own the category at equal weight, but wait: the entry conditions and kill triggers are set out name by name.
- [If frontier AI labs are becoming the next generation of biotech platforms, how should we position?](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/ai-frontier-labs-biotech.md): 2026-10-31. Theme: AI Science. TWST, OABI, DHR, WAT, RVTY, TXG, ILMN, TMO, A, ICLR, CRL, 2395.T, GENB, LLY, NTRA, TEM. Frontier AI labs are buying biotechs, building wet labs and starting their own drug programmes. Design gets cheap and validation stays scarce, so the physical layer gets paid: molecule makers, lab tools, testing services and data owners.
- [Passport Control for Robots: SAIL vs OKTA](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/passport-control-for-robots.md): 2026-10-09. Theme: Cybersecurity. SAIL, OKTA. AI agents pay the identity registry, not the login. Governance is priced per identity, login per employee. Within listed identity, SailPoint owns the better-placed layer at the lower multiple.
- [The Mall Is Closing: Shopify, Meta's Muse and the Agentic Storefront](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/the-mall-is-closing.md): 2026-10-07. Theme: Agentic Commerce. SHOP, META, AMZN. When AI agents do the shopping, the rails get paid every time (Shopify), the assistant that knows the buyer earns a commission (Meta), and the everything store has to reinvent itself or shrink (Amazon).

## Themes
- [Cybersecurity](https://theme-radar.github.io/themes/cybersecurity.md): How AI agents change security spending, and which layers get paid.
- [AI Science](https://theme-radar.github.io/themes/ai-science.md): AI-driven scientific discovery, and the tools, labs and data it runs on.
- [Agentic Commerce](https://theme-radar.github.io/themes/agentic-commerce.md): Agentic shopping, e-commerce, payments and the financial rails underneath.
- [US Dollar Devaluation](https://theme-radar.github.io/themes/us-dollar-devaluation.md): Gold equities as a hedge against a weaker dollar.
- [Payments Value](https://theme-radar.github.io/themes/payments-value.md): Incumbent payment processors priced as value and takeout candidates.

## Thematic Baskets (equal weight, buy-and-hold)
- [Cyber Security](https://theme-radar.github.io/baskets/cyber-security.md): from 2026-09-18, +1.9% since start, label Avoid for now. Fifteen names across the security platforms and services that AI agents depend on: endpoint, network, zero trust, identity, software supply chain, data, observability and recovery.
- [AI Science](https://theme-radar.github.io/baskets/ai-science.md): from 2026-08-17, +16.8% since start, label No signal. Frontier AI labs are becoming biotech platforms, so the physical layer gets paid: molecule makers, lab tools, testing services, AI drug developers and pharma. 14 names, equal weight. SNBL (2395.T) is priced in yen.
- [US Dollar Devaluation](https://theme-radar.github.io/baskets/usd-devaluation.md): from 2026-05-20, -3.9% since start, label Avoid for now. Gold royalty, streaming and mining names as a hedge against a weaker dollar. ALS is priced in Canadian dollars (TSX).
- [Payments Value](https://theme-radar.github.io/baskets/payments-value.md): from 2026-11-02, +5.7% since start, label Already moving. Incumbent payment processors priced as value and takeout candidates: PayPal and Fiserv, equal weight.
